_about: Shared page rules for the link health check. The Yoma API applies the same patterns: soft-not-found and sign-in from CourseQualityPageMatch.cs, bot wall and expired from LinkHealthPageRules.cs (src/api/src/domain/Yoma.Core.Domain/CourseQuality/). Change both together. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions valid in both .NET and JavaScript.

gone._where: Page title, first heading, or the first leadTextLength characters of visible text.

botWall._where: Page title or first heading; the visible text only when the page is shorter than shortPageLength.

signIn._where: Final address path, page title or first heading; the wording only when the page is shorter than shortPageLength.
signIn.name: ^\s*(?:log\s*in|sign\s*in)\b
